notes: Curated material records from primary metal producers with public technical sheets. Each record specifies alloy/grade, temper/condition, product form, and applicable dimensions. Values marked 'typical' represent average production stock; 'minimum' values are standard guarantees per the governing specification. Thickness intervals use the notation (a-b] for exclusive lower bound, [a-b] for inclusive, (a-b) for exclusive both, unless stated otherwise.
